Which statement about hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells is correct?
A
Hydrogen is extracted from clean, dry air.
B
The only product is carbon dioxide.
C
The reaction is endothermic.
D
No toxic gases are produced.

options.label: A
options.text: Hydrogen is extracted from clean, dry air.

options.label: B
options.text: The only product is carbon dioxide.
